guide.title: Setup guide

company.title: Company data complete
company.body: Company tab: legal name, VAT number, tax code and a full Italian address with a 2-letter province (e.g. MI).

taxRegime.title: Tax regime and stamp duty
taxRegime.body: Pick your regime (RF01 ordinary, RF19 flat-rate, …) and the stamp-duty rule. Flat-rate taxpayers and VAT-exempt amounts above €77.47 owe €2 virtual stamp duty.

iban.title: IBAN on your bank account
iban.body: Add the IBAN to a bank account in the Company tab. It is needed for bank-transfer payments (MP05).

connect.title: Connect to PASSO
connect.body: Managed: press “Connect to PASSO”. Manual: paste the API key and seller ID your PASSO operator gave you.

channel.title: Choose the transmission channel
channel.body: PEC is recommended: enter your PEC mailbox credentials. For OpenAPI.it enter its token, then paste the shown inbound URL into the vendor console.

clients.title: Prepare your clients
clients.body: Each client needs an SDI code (codice destinatario) or a PEC address. Foreign clients are handled automatically.

test.title: Test
test.body: Press “Test connection”, then send one invoice and watch it reach “Delivered”.

defaults.title: Pick your defaults
defaults.body: Decide the behaviour for scheduled and recurring invoices and whether to offer the SdI step after finalizing.

guide.sendLater: Send later: an invoice is legally issued only once it reaches SdI, so send it within the deadline ({days} days from the invoice date by default). The dashboard lists everything still pending.
guide.ns: Notification of rejection: NOT issued. Fix the problem and re-issue with a new number.
guide.mc: Delivery failure (impossibilità di recapito): the invoice IS issued. Do NOT resubmit.
guide.at: Attestation of transmission: the invoice is issued; your client finds it in their tax portal.

notice.title: What to enable on OpenAPI.it
notice.intro: Work through these steps in the OpenAPI console. The test below tells you what is still missing.

s1.title: Activate the service and create the token
s1.body: In the OpenAPI console (console.openapi.com: the .com is the console, the SdI API host is .it) activate the SDI service (Sistema di Interscambio, e-invoicing) and create the API key in the same environment you chose here: a sandbox token for Sandbox, a production token for Production. They live on different hosts.

s2.title: Allow these API calls on the token
s2.body: Enable these endpoints on the key:

purposes.sign: Send the invoice signed by the vendor
purposes.registry: Check and create the company registration

whens.legal: Only if you use legal storage

s3.title: Register your company once
s3.body: In the console, open the business registries (Business registry configurations) and add your company:
s3.fiscalId: Fiscal ID: {vat} (your VAT number without the IT prefix). Also enter the company name and an e-mail address.
s3.fiscalIdExample: Fiscal ID: your VAT number without the IT prefix, for example {vat}. Also enter the company name and an e-mail address.
s3.signingOn: Choose signing ON, to match the switch above.
s3.signingOff: Choose signing OFF, to match the switch above.
s3.mismatch: ON accepts only signed submissions, OFF only unsigned ones. A mismatch makes every invoice fail with error 387.

s4.title: Keep credit in the OpenAPI wallet
s4.body: Sending and reading invoice records are billed. With an empty wallet, invoices end as Failed and can be retried after you top up.

s5.title: Optional: set up the callback
s5.body: After saving, paste the inbound URL shown here in the console for the customer-notification event. It must be reachable from the internet.

notice.tip: Start with Sandbox: invoices are not sent to the real tax authority.

reset.title: Reset the e-invoicing connection?
reset.message: Sending to SdI is switched off and the local connection (PASSO tenant link, API key, seller, channel and webhook) is cleared. Invoices already sent are not affected. The PASSO tenant itself is NOT deleted: it is re-used when you reconnect.
reset.done: Connection reset. Set it up again with the steps below.

wizard.title: Set up e-invoicing
wizard.hint: Follow these steps to start sending invoices to SdI. You can come back at any time.

company.hint: Billy fills in the seller section of every e-invoice from your company data, so it has to be complete first.
company.ibanHint: Without an IBAN invoices can still be sent, but the bank details will be missing. You can add it in the Company tab.

connect.managedHint: Billy creates your PASSO account, API key and webhook in one click.
connect.manualHint: Ask your PASSO operator for an API key and a seller ID, then paste them here.
connect.manualIncomplete: Saved, but the connection is not complete yet: both an API key and a seller ID are needed.

channel.required: Set up the transmission channel to continue.
channel.manualNote: In manual mode the PASSO operator configures the transmission channel, so there is nothing to do here. This step is skipped.

test.hint: Check that everything works before you switch sending on. Every check must pass (a missing webhook is fine: Billy will poll instead).

finish.hint: Last choices. Everything else can be fine-tuned afterwards in the full settings.

lineItems.indicative: Totals are indicative — the server recalculates on save.
